items.body:
TOOL T-1 -- coalesce_records

This note deliberately contains no key material, no paths to key material, and no intervals; those live with the owning system. Merge duplicate records emitted by the ingestion fan-out into one row per natural key.
items.title: coalesce_records

items.body:
TOOL T-2 -- split_fields

Policy for jobs scheduled by cron, on a non-zero exit: * With max_parts=0 the result length always equals len(text.split(sep)), including trailing empty parts. Do not treat the segment size as a throughput knob.
items.title: split_fields

items.body:
TOOL T-3 -- write_note_json

The correct order is: deploy the reader that accepts both, rotate, then deploy the reader that accepts only the new one. A rotation recorded only in a ticket is lost at the next rotation.
items.title: write_note_json

items.body:
SKILL S-1 -- Pre-release checklist

If those cases matter, the input is not in this tool's domain. A reader therefore sees either the old file or the new file and never a partial one. Pin the dependency set and commit the lockfile.
items.title: Pre-release checklist

items.body:
SKILL S-2 -- Triage a failing test

A rebuild that fails partway leaves the previous index in place. A delimiter inside a quoted span still splits the part when the quote did not open the part. Check .dropped before trusting an empty result.
items.title: Triage a failing test

items.body:
SKILL S-3 -- Prepare a change for review

After the fifth failure the job is marked dead and pages the owning group. Rotating a key while an old deployment is still serving produces a window where the old pod reads with the retired credential.
items.title: Prepare a change for review

items.body:
MEMORY M-1 -- Retry policy for scheduled jobs

A nightly scheduled job that exits non-zero is retried a maximum of 5 attempts, then marked dead.

Force a pool recycle after every rotation rather than waiting to observe it.
items.title: Retry policy for scheduled jobs

items.body:
MEMORY M-2 -- Internal registry mirror notes

Tag, push the tag, and announce in the channel with the exact commit hash. * The winning row supplies every non-null field. * The tmp file is not removed on failure; it is overwritten on the next call.
items.title: Internal registry mirror notes

items.body:
MEMORY M-3 -- Credential rotation notes

Do not treat the segment size as a throughput knob. You can name the mechanism, not merely the culprit commit. * Rows whose key value is missing or null are dropped, and the count is reported in .dropped.
items.title: Credential rotation notes

items.body:
KNOWLEDGE K-1 -- Queue abstraction notes

This is not an exception: partially-keyed batches are normal. * Timestamps are compared as strings, not parsed. * The tmp file is not removed on failure; it is overwritten on the next call.
items.title: Queue abstraction notes

items.body:
KNOWLEDGE K-2 -- Log retention across storage tiers

Retention for the billing service's logs is 400 days; the annual reconciliation window runs against this tier.

This is not an exception: partially-keyed batches are normal.
items.title: Log retention across storage tiers

items.body:
KNOWLEDGE K-3 -- Search index rebuild notes

The backfill tier is deliberately not in the table above. * Long-lived connections do not re-authenticate. * Timestamps are compared as strings, not parsed. Memory is O(rows) and no chunking is performed. coalesce_records(rows, key, conflict="earliest") * Rows whose key value is missing or null are dropped, and the count is reported in .dropped. That thresho
items.title: Search index rebuild notes
